gen-gf-bellota-gf-hanuman: Distinctive from the first glance, Bellota draws its curves and straights with one stylus width, while Hanuman, a serif, sits high-waisted underneath it. Their line quality is the whole story.
gen-gf-bellota-gf-kadwa: Bellota's s swings its ends far from the spine, all in one marker-like line. Kadwa, a text serif, gives its large x-height and open-ended curves room to carry a long stretch of reading without tiring the eye.
gen-gf-bellota-gf-noticia-text: Rounded, unshaded, a bit stubborn. Bellota's o is a ring with a constant wall, and Noticia Text answers with entrances into its curves and lowercase that fill most of the letter height.
gen-gf-bellota-gf-piazzolla: Authoritative Piazzolla has lowercase nearly matching its capitals and an e opened like a pried clasp, while Bellota makes every diagonal as stout as every upright. And if the heading goes noticeably larger than the body, that gap suits them.
gen-gf-bellota-gf-pridi: That far-hanging s in Bellota, drawn with a single stylus width, gives the heading its odd charm. Pridi, a classic serif, then follows with generous curve-to-stem space and near-capital small letters that make a long passage feel unhurried.
gen-gf-bellota-gf-scope-one: Scope One reads sturdy and spacious, with counters spilling outward and stubby ascenders beside a big x-height. Bellota earns its keep when big and short, where its marker-like line can show off.
gen-gf-bellota-gf-slabo-13px: Bellota keeps a quiet, level beat, with no accents of weight and an s whose ends hang far out. Slabo 13px, a text serif, does the opposite job, spending its tall, open a, e and s on steady reading.
gen-gf-bellota-gf-suwannaphum: Suwannaphum brings a squared-off, woodblock-high x-height and a c as open as a bent paperclip. Under Bellota's constant-width strokes, a longer passage would read dignified and sturdy, with plenty of daylight inside each letter.
gen-gf-bellota-text-gf-epunda-slab: Open, unshaded and bold in presence, Bellota Text has no pressure swells to slow the eye. Epunda Slab, a text serif, has a gaping c and tall rounded lowercase, so a longer passage would feel welcoming and sturdy.
gen-gf-bellota-text-gf-fauna-one: Open shapes, no shading, plenty of nerve: that is Bellota Text, built to command attention. But Fauna One, a serif, does the quieter work, with a tall middle band and a generous entry into the e.
